astro-ph.CO.name: Cosmology and Nongalactic Astrophysics
astro-ph.CO.description: Phenomenology of early universe, cosmic microwave background, cosmological parameters, primordial element abundances, extragalactic distance scale, large-scale structure of the universe. Groups, superclusters, voids, intergalactic medium. Particle astrophysics: dark energy, dark matter, baryogenesis, leptogenesis, inflationary models, reheating, monopoles, WIMPs, cosmic strings, primordial black holes, cosmological gravitational radiation.

astro-ph.EP.name: Earth and Planetary Astrophysics
astro-ph.EP.description: Interplanetary medium, planetary physics, planetary astrobiology, extrasolar planets, comets, asteroids, meteorites. Structure and formation of the solar system.

astro-ph.GA.name: Astrophysics of Galaxies
astro-ph.GA.description: Phenomena pertaining to galaxies or the Milky Way. Star clusters, HII regions and planetary nebulae, the interstellar medium, atomic and molecular clouds, dust. Stellar populations. Galactic structure, formation, dynamics. Galactic nuclei, bulges, disks, halo. Active Galactic Nuclei, supermassive black holes, quasars. Gravitational lens systems. The Milky Way and its contents.

astro-ph.HE.name: High Energy Astrophysical Phenomena
astro-ph.HE.description: Cosmic ray production, acceleration, propagation, detection. Gamma ray astronomy and bursts, X-rays, charged particles, supernovae and other explosive phenomena, stellar remnants and accretion systems, jets, microquasars, neutron stars, pulsars, black holes.

astro-ph.IM.name: Instrumentation and Methods for Astrophysics
astro-ph.IM.description: Detector and telescope design, experiment proposals. Laboratory Astrophysics. Methods for data analysis, statistical methods. Software, database design.

astro-ph.SR.name: Solar and Stellar Astrophysics
astro-ph.SR.description: White dwarfs, brown dwarfs, cataclysmic variables. Star formation and protostellar systems, stellar astrobiology, binary and multiple systems of stars, stellar evolution and structure, coronas. Central stars of planetary nebulae. Helioseismology, solar neutrinos, production and detection of gravitational radiation from stellar systems.

cond-mat.dis-nn.name: Disordered Systems and Neural Networks
cond-mat.dis-nn.description: Glasses and spin glasses; properties of random, aperiodic and quasiperiodic systems; transport in disordered media; localization; phenomena mediated by defects and disorder; neural networks.

cond-mat.mes-hall.name: Mesoscale and Nanoscale Physics
cond-mat.mes-hall.description: Semiconducting nanostructures: quantum dots, wires, and wells. Single electronics, spintronics, 2d electron gases, quantum Hall effect, nanotubes, graphene, plasmonic nanostructures.

cond-mat.mtrl-sci.name: Materials Science
cond-mat.mtrl-sci.description: Techniques, synthesis, characterization, structure. Structural phase transitions, mechanical properties, phonons. Defects, adsorbates, interfaces.

cond-mat.other.name: Other Condensed Matter
cond-mat.other.description: Work in condensed matter that does not fit into the other cond-mat classifications.

cond-mat.quant-gas.name: Quantum Gases
cond-mat.quant-gas.description: Ultracold atomic and molecular gases, Bose-Einstein condensation, Feshbach resonances, spinor condensates, optical lattices, quantum simulation with cold atoms and molecules, macroscopic interference phenomena.

cond-mat.soft.name: Soft Condensed Matter
cond-mat.soft.description: Membranes, polymers, liquid crystals, glasses, colloids, granular matter.

cond-mat.stat-mech.name: Statistical Mechanics
cond-mat.stat-mech.description: Phase transitions, thermodynamics, field theory, non-equilibrium phenomena, renormalization group and scaling, integrable models, turbulence.

cond-mat.str-el.name: Strongly Correlated Electrons
cond-mat.str-el.description: Quantum magnetism, non-Fermi liquids, spin liquids, quantum criticality, charge density waves, metal-insulator transitions.

cond-mat.supr-con.name: Superconductivity
cond-mat.supr-con.description: Superconductivity: theory, models, experiment. Superflow in helium.

physics.acc-ph.name: Accelerator Physics
physics.acc-ph.description: Accelerator theory, technology, experiments, beam physics, design and optimization, radiation sources.

physics.ao-ph.name: Atmospheric and Oceanic Physics
physics.ao-ph.description: Atmospheric and oceanic physics and physical chemistry, biogeophysics, and climate science.

physics.app-ph.name: Applied Physics
physics.app-ph.description: Applications of physics to new technology, including electronic devices, optics, photonics, microwaves, spintronics, advanced materials, metamaterials, nanotechnology, and energy sciences.

physics.bio-ph.name: Biological Physics
physics.bio-ph.description: Molecular, cellular, neurological, membrane, and single-molecule biophysics; quantum phenomena in biological systems.

physics.chem-ph.name: Chemical Physics
physics.chem-ph.description: Experimental, computational, and theoretical physics of atoms, molecules, and clusters; chemical thermodynamics.

physics.class-ph.name: Classical Physics
physics.class-ph.description: Newtonian and relativistic dynamics; many particle systems; chaos; electromagnetism; acoustics.

physics.comp-ph.name: Computational Physics
physics.comp-ph.description: All aspects of computational science applied to physics.

physics.data-an.name: Data Analysis, Statistics and Probability
physics.data-an.description: Methods, software and hardware for physics data analysis; measurement methodology; uncertainties.

physics.flu-dyn.name: Fluid Dynamics
physics.flu-dyn.description: Turbulence, instabilities, incompressible/compressible flows, reacting flows.

physics.geo-ph.name: Geophysics
physics.geo-ph.description: Atmospheric, computational geophysics, planetology, solar system, solid earth geophysics.

physics.hist-ph.name: History and Philosophy of Physics
physics.hist-ph.description: History and philosophy of all branches of physics, astrophysics, and cosmology.

physics.ins-det.name: Instrumentation and Detectors
physics.ins-det.description: Instrumentation and detectors for research in natural science; associated electronics and control equipment.

physics.med-ph.name: Medical Physics
physics.med-ph.description: Radiation therapy, dosimetry, biomedical imaging modelling, health physics.

physics.optics.name: Optics
physics.optics.description: Fiber optics, laser applications, quantum optics, ultrafast optics, X-ray optics.

physics.plasm-ph.name: Plasma Physics
physics.plasm-ph.description: Fundamental plasma physics, magnetically confined plasmas, high energy density plasmas.

physics.soc-ph.name: Physics and Society
physics.soc-ph.description: Structure, dynamics and collective behavior of societies; social networks; infrastructure systems.

physics.space-ph.name: Space Physics
physics.space-ph.description: Space plasma physics, heliophysics, space weather, planetary magnetospheres.

q-bio.BM.name: Biomolecules
q-bio.BM.description: DNA, RNA, proteins, lipids; structures and folding kinetics.

q-bio.GN.name: Genomics
q-bio.GN.description: DNA sequencing, gene finding, mutational processes.
